This is an unique case. It _is_ legible, but I think a code example here would be more beneficial. Say, and I am spitballing here:
```suggestion
				[codeblock]
				func _get_dependencies(path, add_types):
					return [
						"uid://fqgvuwrkuixh::Script::res://script.gd",
						"uid://fqgvuwrkuixh::::res://script.gd",
						"res://script.gd::Script",
						"res://script.gd",
					]
				[/codeblock]
```
This is obviously not ideal, because the description states how each section should be included, but I think the gist is clear.

It's same as the original description:

https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/019ab8745fb74c2f0e479c83fa1f029eee75ea2c/doc/classes/ResourceFormatLoader.xml#L32

You'll get a `type="Resource"` in the tscn file if such a resource is assigned to `@export var res: CustomRes` in the scene. This field is what `get_dependencies()` uses for the second section.

```
[ext_resource type="Resource" uid="uid://dofpixe0ekls" path="res://missing_lv3/level_3.tres" id="2_bm4yp"]
```
